name: Blacksmiths beneath a thatched shelter, with the church of S. Antonio, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of blacksmiths working in the shade of a thatched awning set up on poles; the street on the left leads to the church of S. Antonio (St Anthony), Macau.  See E.1691-1928 for a similar view.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
